title: Three normalized traces upgrade collective weak limits to whole-state trace convergence

statement.quantifiers: Every fixed A in(0,1), real b, and converging A_N->A,b_N->b within the open window; every finite N has the explicit full-separable ensemble.
statement.assertion: For iid uniform Bloch R_i,U_N=sumR_i/sqrtN, p_A(u)=exp[-9A|u|^2/(4(1-A))-3b u_z/(2(1-A))], sigma_N=E[p_A(U_N) tensor_i(I+R_i·sigma)/2]/E p_A(U_N); eta_N=e^(-A J²/N-b Jz/sqrtN)/(2^N Z_N). ||2^N sigma_N-H_N/Z_N||_(2,tau)->0 and D(sigma_N,eta_N)->0, locally uniformly on compact interior parameters.
assumptions: Normalized tracial state tau_N=2^-N Tr; D=halftrace.
All heterogeneous factors and correlated classical weighting permitted.
Gaussian Fourier transform integrable, local B(v) contraction.
Maxwell spin-sector limit and complex SL2 character cross trace with uniform Gaussian domination.

inputs: Explicit correlated product ensemble and angular Fourier contraction; three H²,Q²,HQ trace limits.
outputs: Whole-state trace approximation to a positive collective Gibbs component.
interface.precision: Asymptotic full trace norm; no finite-N convergence rate or endpoint A=1 assertion.
costs: Classical rejection/sampling, endpoint truncation, random sphere draws and finite-bit costs separately charged in COST_ADDENDUM.
This lemma does not certify finite-N stationary-state error.

proof_mechanism: Fourier sphere integration B(v)=sinc|v| I+i d(|v|)vhat·sigma, ||B||<=1.
Tensor expansion converges in normalized tracial L2 to e^(-|k|²/9)e^(i(2/3)k·J/sqrtN).
Prove normalized H²,Q²,HQ limits; cross term uses spin-block character of exp(-b sigma_z/(2sqrtN))exp(i k·sigma/(2sqrtN)), not weak CLT alone.
Positive converging normalizers and tau|T|<=||T||_(2,tau) convert squared-norm cancellation to whole-state halftrace.
obstructions: Weak convergence of collective observables alone cannot imply trace distance.
A=1 weight singular, A>1 outside construction; no zero-distance conclusion above lower-witness crossing.
Replacing all bad mixture mass by identity gives only an upper bound, not exact optimal distance.

potential_uses.transfer_gate: Construct an admitted positive finite-dimensional ensemble and independently establish all three normalized traces, domination and nonzero normalizers; retain sample/precision and finite-size-rate debts.

review.source_reported: Separate internal audits reconstructed selected modules and repaired an earlier gap; no new ingestion proof reconstruction or scientific replay.
